name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Partner Enablement & GenAI Content Professional | Channel Programs, Training & Scalable Content Systems
summary: Partner enablement and channel professional with 15+ years building scalable programs that drive partner adoption and revenue, including hands-on, daily use of Generative AI to accelerate content creation and workflow productivity. Has onboarded and trained a diverse, high-volume reseller partner network, built sales training curriculum for tenured reps, and architects AI-driven systems that turn a single playbook into ready-to-execute assets at scale.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Use Generative AI as a core part of daily workflow, architecting agent systems that translate business goals into structured content, outreach sequences, and automated deliverables at scale.
Build reusable, template-based marketing assets and messaging frameworks, adapting a shared base to each client's brand rather than starting from scratch, a one-to-many content model.

Evaluate and pilot GenAI and automation tools (GoHighLevel, Zapier, Make, n8n), recommending the platform that best fits each client's requirements, and design evaluation frameworks with rubric-based grading to keep AI-generated output accurate.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume reseller partner network, driving rapid adoption of marketing-automation and reputation-management solutions.
Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction across the partner network.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, analyzing utilization and performance data to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Drove team initiatives and process improvements for a brand-new Wix vertical, developing sales training curriculum for tenured account executives in addition to onboarding for new hires.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (a team of 20, later a team of 8), building the training and process documentation the team ran on.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
